experiment: ECL Alpaca IEX 15-minute return regression v1
target: The existing exact close-to-close return at t+15 minutes; same continuous New York session segment. No recalculation using an alternate label rule.

directional_conversion.exact_zero_tie: DOWN, to provide a binary result at the fixed zero boundary

features: Exact 24 ordered B features from the v3 feature schema; no added features.
splits: Approved train.csv through 2026-08-05, validation.csv 2026-08-06 through 2026-09-24. No test split or later data is used.

walk_forward.fold_schedule: Established four expanding chronological folds from the prior binary study.
walk_forward.neutral_rows: Retained during regression fitting because the target is continuous; directional evaluation is restricted to actual UP/DOWN classes.
walk_forward.purge: Drop training samples with future_datetime at or after first held-out decision timestamp.
walk_forward.preprocessing: Simple median imputation fitted inside each fold; Ridge additionally uses StandardScaler fitted inside each fold.

selection: No threshold tuning. Compare all fixed models; validation is a single limited confirmation after chronological OOF results.
baseline_predictions: Use saved v3 RF/XGBoost OOF and validation predictions, aligned by exact decision timestamp. Do not re-infer those baselines.
